items.name: apple
items.title: Apple
items.description: Every Apple token as CSS variables (light and dark) plus the type, material, glass, hairline and press utilities.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: An inset grouped list of disclosure rows that each reveal a panel, one open at a time unless multiple.

items.name: action-sheet
items.title: Action sheet
items.description: Choices related to an action: the iOS 26 card with 48 pt capsule actions from the bottom on a phone, a popover anchored to the control from the sm breakpoint.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert
items.description: The iOS 26 alert: 320 pt, 34 pt corners, Liquid Glass, left-aligned text and 48 pt capsule actions; AppKit’s 260 pt alert with 28 pt push buttons on macOS.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person’s picture or their monogram on gray.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: The red count capsule, and tinted or filled tags.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: The path to the current location as links separated by chevrons — the Finder’s path bar, apple.com’s breadcrumbs.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button group
items.description: Adjacent buttons joined into one control — AppKit’s segmented push buttons, apple.com’s paired actions.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Filled, tinted, gray, bordered, plain, glass and destructive buttons in the five control sizes — a 34 pt capsule on iOS 26, a 24 pt rounded rectangle on macOS 26, apple.com’s 36 px pill on the web.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A group box on the grouped card surface with the platform’s card corner.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A snapping horizontal shelf of items with a page control, scrolled natively — the App Store’s shelves.

items.name: checkbox-group
items.title: Checkbox group
items.description: Checkboxes that share a value under a parent that turns them all on or off and shows the mixed state — macOS’s settings hierarchy.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A 22 pt circle on iOS, a 16 pt rounded square on the bezel on macOS 26, with a mixed state.

items.name: color-well
items.title: Color well
items.description: The native colour input as Apple presents it: a ring around the swatch on iOS, AppKit’s capsule on macOS.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combo box
items.description: A text field that offers suggestions filtered as the person types, in a glass menu with the platform’s rows.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context menu
items.description: The same menu, opened by a secondary click or a long press on an item.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal card: the macOS sheet and the iPad form sheet, on the platform’s dialog corner and width.

items.name: disclosure-group
items.title: Disclosure group
items.description: A row that reveals details, its chevron turning as it opens.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: The unavailable-content view: a symbol, a title, a description and an action.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A labelled control with a description and an error, wired together for assistive technology.

items.name: glass
items.title: Glass
items.description: Liquid Glass for the functional layer: regular, clear and prominent, as a capsule, rounded rectangle or circle.

items.name: icon
items.title: Icon
items.description: Hugeicons rendered with the SF Symbols sizing model: scales relative to text and weights that follow it.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: The bordered text field on every platform — 34 pt with 5 pt corners on iOS 26, AppKit’s 24 pt bezel, the App Store’s 32 px field — plus filled and plain variants and the iOS clear button.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A keyboard key, as shown beside menu items.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: A control’s label in body text.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: A link in the link colour: apple.com’s “Learn more ›” with its chevron, a pill button, or a quiet inline link.

items.name: list
items.title: List
items.description: Plain, grouped, inset grouped and sidebar lists with rows, accessories and sections — 26 pt corners and 52 pt rows on iOS 26, 10 pt corners and 28 pt rows on macOS 26.

items.name: lockup
items.title: Lockup
items.description: The App Store’s product lockup: an icon on the icon mask, a title, a subtitle and the Get button.

items.name: material
items.title: Material
items.description: A content-layer material from ultra-thin to thick that blurs what is behind it.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: Liquid Glass menus: 250 pt panels of 44 pt rows with leading glyphs on iOS 26; AppKit’s 24 pt rows, hairlines and accent highlight on macOS 26.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menu bar
items.description: The macOS menu bar: top-level menus whose titles highlight with the accent while open, each a full menu with shortcuts and submenus.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: Gauges for a value in a range that is not progress: the linear meter with a label and percentage, and the circular gauge with the value in the centre.

items.name: navigation-bar
items.title: Navigation bar
items.description: A 54 pt row with 44 pt glass platters and the 34 pt large title that collapses as content scrolls under it.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation menu
items.description: apple.com’s global navigation: a 44 pt material bar of small links with full-width flyout panels of large links under eyebrows.

items.name: page-control
items.title: Page control
items.description: A row of dots for a flat sequence of pages.

items.name: passcode-field
items.title: Passcode field
items.description: A row of one-character boxes for a verification code that advances as digits are typed and fills on paste.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A transient Liquid Glass card with an arrow, on the platform’s popover corner.

items.name: preview-card
items.title: Preview card
items.description: Safari’s link preview: a Liquid Glass card that appears after hovering a link for a moment.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: The 4 pt linear bar and the circular ring, determinate or indeterminate.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: Two to five mutually exclusive options as rings that fill with the tint and show a white dot.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: The App Store’s five stars: read-only with the value in its name, or a radio group the person can set.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll area
items.description: A scroll view with Apple’s overlay scrollbars, which fade in while scrolling and never take layout space.

items.name: search-field
items.title: Search field
items.description: The 44 pt capsule search field of iOS 26 with the magnifier, clear and Cancel; AppKit’s 24 pt capsule on macOS.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented control
items.description: Equal segments with a sliding selection: a white pill in a 32 pt capsule on iOS 26, the accent fill in a 24 pt rounded rectangle on macOS 26.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: The menu picker: a tinted inline value on iOS, AppKit’s pop-up button bezel on macOS 26, a pill on the web, opening a glass menu with leading check marks.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: The half-point hairline, inset after a row’s leading content when it divides a list.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A bottom sheet with a grabber and detents on phones, a centred card from the sm breakpoint.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: A navigation list on the regular material: 44 pt rows on iPad, AppKit’s 28 pt rows with 6 pt corners on macOS 26, Music’s 34 pt rows on the web.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A redacted placeholder for loading content.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A 6 pt track with the 37×24 pill knob on iOS 26 (a 20×16 oval on macOS 26) and optional images at either end.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: The activity indicator: eight fading bars at the medium and large sizes.

items.name: split-view
items.title: Split view
items.description: Two or three adjacent panes with hairline dividers that stack on narrow screens.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: The 94×32 pt capsule with − and + halves on iOS 26; AppKit’s 20×26 vertical stepper on macOS 26.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: The iOS 26 switch: a 63×28 pt track with a 37×24 oval knob that stretches while pressed; 54×24 on macOS 26. Green or tinted when on.

items.name: tab-bar
items.title: Tab bar
items.description: The iOS 26 tab bar: a 62 pt Liquid Glass platter inset 21 pt with 54 pt items, the current one on a tinted lens, and a separate search circle; minimises on scroll.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: The macOS table with small column headers, compact rows and a tinted selection.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: A segmented control that switches between related subviews.

items.name: text
items.title: Text
items.description: A label in one of the eleven text styles, with the label colour roles and per-style emphasis.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: The text view for longer text, on the same surface as the text field.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Notification banners: a Liquid Glass card with an icon, title and message that drops in from the top and can be swiped away.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle group
items.description: A joined set of toggle buttons in the segmented control’s geometry, single- or multi-select — Keynote’s bold, italic and underline.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A toggle button whose pressed state is the tinted fill, for options outside a list.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: Items in floating glass platters — 44 pt circles inset 4 on iOS 26, 28 pt on macOS and the web — with the prominent action filled.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A brief phrase on thick material after a short hover.

items.name: window
items.title: Window
items.description: A macOS 26 window: 16 pt corners, the title bar with its traffic lights or the unified toolbar, and the dialog shadow.

items.name: use-media-query
items.title: useMediaQuery
items.description: Tracks a media query; useIsDesktop is the sheet breakpoint.

items.name: use-scroll-collapse
items.title: useScrollCollapse
items.description: Reports when a large title has scrolled under the bar.

items.name: utils
items.title: cn
items.description: Class merging.

items.name: platform
items.title: Platform
items.description: PlatformProvider and usePlatform: the iOS/macOS idiom switch.

items.name: contrast
items.title: Contrast
items.description: WCAG luminance, compositing and contrast ratio.
